title: Mechanical landscape-orthographic mask and outcome-neutral validator correction for P1
question: What P1 pass viability result follows when the same immutable eight EXRs are measured with Blender's landscape orthographic extent and an outcome-neutral projection validator?
decisionRole: post-hoc mechanical correction of a retained formal analysis failure; no new render and no temporal reconstruction promotion

requirements: All three corrected tools and the corrected output root are absent at C1 preregistration.
The original formal root, invalid analyzer, invalid result and failure receipt remain byte-preserved.
C1 launches zero Blender processes and performs zero renders.
C1 creates a fresh root once, extracts all 24 arrays again from the immutable EXRs, and runs analyzer plus independent audit in separate processes.

permittedCorrections.outcomeNeutralProjectionValidation: Recompute each mechanism gate and the same frozen four-label verdict mapping; validation passes when the reported result equals that recomputation, regardless of which label is selected.
permittedCorrections.schemaAndPaths: Use C1 experiment, schema, tool and output identities.

forbiddenChanges: changing any source EXR or source report byte
changing resolution, samples, frames, displays, repeats, scene geometry, owner locations or pass assignments
changing the three-pixel stable-interior margin or 256-pixel minimum
changing expected Object Index 7/7, Material Index 11/23 or AOV 0.25/0.75
changing any original common or mechanism-specific candidate gate
using a rendered pass to define or shrink the analytic stable-interior masks
dropping boundary characterization, display invariance or clean-repeat identity
adding a threshold, tolerance, rounding, remapping or temporal reconstruction claim
deleting or overwriting the failed P1 artifacts

correctedMeasurementContract.analyticProjection: Use only the frozen camera, resolution, geometry and permitted landscape extent; compute pixel-center masks independently of rendered passes.
correctedMeasurementContract.payloadIdentity: All 24 corrected extracted float32 payloads must be byte-identical to the 24 preserved P1 extracted payloads and the raw EXR parts.
correctedMeasurementContract.sourceIdentity: All eight report and EXR hashes must match sourceManifest before measurement.
correctedMeasurementContract.gateIdentity: All P1 candidate gates and the four decision labels remain exact.
correctedMeasurementContract.audit: An independent raw-EXR audit must recompute masks, measurements, payload bytes, invariance, viability and verdict mapping without importing the corrected analyzer.

requiredTargets: make projection validation require both candidates

decision.promotion: A corrected viable pass label is post-hoc transport evidence and may justify a separately preregistered fresh H1 integration intervention; it is not itself fresh holdout evidence.

nonClaims: C1 does not turn the failed original P1 analyzer result into a valid result; it emits a separate correction result.
C1 is post-hoc and not a fresh holdout.
Pass transport viability does not prove temporal reconstruction safety at owner boundaries.
Material Index viability does not solve multi-material owner assignment automatically.
Custom AOV viability does not prove arbitrary material graphs can always be injected safely.
No D12.9-H1 verdict, perceptual quality, cost or production claim changes.
